name: Dell Technologies Inc.

peers.name: Hewlett Packard Enterprise
peers.why: Servers (incl. AI), storage and networking to the same enterprise buyers

peers.why: Pure AI-server rival for the same GPU-server deals

peers.why: Main PC rival to Dell's Client Solutions Group

peers.why: Builds AI and networking hardware for the same cloud buyers

peers.why: Largest contract maker of AI servers for hyperscalers: the build-it-yourself alternative to Dell

valuation.vl3_basis: trailing P/E, 5 years (price / last-12-month SEC diluted EPS), labelled

dm4.name: AI server orders
dm4.source: Dell quarterly results release (AI-optimized server orders booked; on results)
dm4.measured_against: the same 2 quarters a year earlier (sum of the last 2 quarters)
dm4.what: New AI server orders Dell booked over the last two quarters vs the same two quarters a year earlier.
dm4.why: Orders show demand before it becomes revenue; two quarters smooth out single giant deals.
dm4.bull_means: AI order intake is growing: future revenue is being filled in.
dm4.neutral_means: AI orders are flat vs a year ago.
dm4.bear_means: AI orders are shrinking: future AI revenue is at risk.
dm4._threshold_note: Raised 6 Oct 2026 (Kenneth, adversarial pass) from +20% / 0% so a slowdown shows before orders actually fall.

dm4.name: Commercial PC revenue growth
dm4.source: Dell quarterly results release (CSG commercial client revenue; on results)
dm4.what: Growth in revenue from PCs sold to businesses and governments vs the same quarter last year.
dm4.why: About a quarter of Dell's revenue; a demand read that does not depend on AI.
dm4.bull_means: Businesses are upgrading PCs: the non-AI half of Dell is growing.
dm4.neutral_means: Business PC sales are roughly flat.

dm4.name: Storage revenue growth
dm4.source: Dell quarterly results release (ISG storage revenue; on results)
dm4.what: Growth in Dell's storage revenue vs the same quarter last year.
dm4.why: Storage is Dell's highest-margin hardware and had been shrinking; growth here lifts profit more than AI servers do.
dm4.bull_means: Storage is growing: the profitable part of ISG is healthy.
dm4.bear_means: Storage is shrinking: a hit to Dell's best margins.

dm5.name: Taiwan AI-server makers' monthly sales
dm5.source: TWSE MOPS monthly revenue (Quanta 2382, Wistron 3231, Wiwynn 6669), free; published by the 10th of each month
dm5.measured_against: the same 3 months a year earlier (combined sales of the three, NT$)
dm5.latest: +96.8% (Jun-Aug 2026 NT$2,639bn vs NT$1,341bn a year earlier; MOPS, checked 5 Oct 2026)
dm5.what: Combined monthly sales of Taiwan's three biggest AI-server makers over the last 3 months vs the same months a year earlier.
dm5.why: They build the servers for the same AI buyers and report monthly, so they show AI demand weeks before Dell's quarterly results.
dm5.bull_means: AI server building across the industry is growing fast.
dm5.neutral_means: Industry AI server sales are flat-ish.
dm5.bear_means: Industry AI server sales are shrinking: an early warning for Dell's AI orders.

overrides.what: Bullish at +50% or more, bearish at +15% or less (framework default: set per stock)
overrides.reason: In an AI build-out boom, +20% / 0% lines would read bullish almost regardless of a slowdown; Kenneth, 6 Oct 2026.

_sec_rev_tag_note: Dell files total revenue under us-gaap:Revenues (the default tag has no quarters). Stage B must run with __CFG.revTag='Revenues'. Open item for the Framework chat: the production task must read this setting (same as NVDA).
_splits_note: Not a true split: Yahoo treats the VMware spin-off (1 Nov 2021) as a 1.973-for-1 split and adjusts older prices; listed so old SEC EPS lines up with Yahoo's adjusted prices.

mix._note: Revenue mix (plan v0.4, not scored). Source set to MANUAL on 6 Oct 2026 (adversarial pass): the engine cannot derive servers & networking for the Jan 2026 quarter from SEC rows (Dell changed the row labels in FY27), although it follows from the filings: ISG minus storage = $14,805m. Quarters are taken from SEC filings (stage D raw, archive/2026-10-05/rawD.txt) into side.json mix.quarters; Q4 = full year minus the first three quarters. Switch back to source 'sec' after Dell's Q3 FY27 10-Q (early Dec 2026) restates Oct 2025, and then split AI servers into their own part. Match patterns kept for that switch.
mix.note: Segment operating margin = the segment's operating profit ÷ its revenue, before costs Dell does not allocate (mainly amortisation of purchase intangibles, share-based pay and other corporate costs). Dell reports profit only for ISG and CSG, so servers and storage share ISG's margin, and commercial and consumer PCs share CSG's.

_onboard_note: Price at the first staging build (5 Oct 2026 close): the reference for O6 winner discipline until a positions feed exists.
